manual.title: Run the content pipeline from idea to scheduled post.
manual.subtitle: Impulso is organized around three working stages: generate drafts, curate and design the best ones, then schedule finished posts.

generate.title: Generate
generate.description: Describe a topic or theme and Impulso writes a batch of tweet angles for your account.

steps.0: Choose the Twitter account you want to work on.
steps.1: Pick a tone, language, and number of drafts.
steps.2: Use a suggested topic or write a custom prompt.
steps.3: Generate drafts, then keep the ones worth shaping.

details.0: Enter a topic, trend, or idea you want to post about
details.1: Choose a tone: Professional, Casual, Witty, Authoritative, Inspirational, or Custom
details.2: Select a language and number of drafts to generate
details.3: AI produces multiple tweet variations you can review

curate.title: Curate & Design
curate.description: Review drafts, approve the ones you like, add design briefs, and generate images.

steps.0: Review generated copy in the Draft column.
steps.1: Approve strong posts and move them through the board.
steps.2: Add or refine visual direction before generating images.
steps.3: Regenerate images with feedback when the first result misses.

details.0: Drag cards across four stages: Draft → Curated → Designed → Image ready
details.1: Approve drafts to move them to the Curated column
details.2: Add a visual brief describing the image you want
details.3: Generate images with AI (GPT Image, Gemini Flash, or DALL·E 3)
details.4: Regenerate images with feedback until they look right

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Drag ready posts onto your weekly calendar to plan when each tweet goes out.

steps.0: Drag image-ready posts from the tray into a calendar day.
steps.1: Impulso chooses the next available publishing slot for that day.
steps.2: Preview scheduled posts before they go live.
steps.3: Unschedule anything that needs another pass.

details.0: Ready posts appear in the tray on the left
details.1: Drag them onto any day of the week
details.2: Set the exact time for each post
details.3: Preview how the post will look on X before publishing

publish.title: Publish
publish.description: Impulso publishes your scheduled tweets automatically via your connected X account.

details.0: Connect each X account independently in Settings → X accounts
details.1: Scheduled posts are published automatically at the set time
details.2: Track post status: Scheduled → Publishing → Posted
details.3: View engagement after a post goes live

images.title: Images
images.text: A post needs a visual brief before image generation. Use short feedback to steer regenerations.

publishing.title: Publishing
publishing.text: Scheduled posts are handled by the publishing job. Failed posts stay visible so they can be checked.

brandKit.title: Brand kit
brandKit.text: Upload your logo, set brand colors, and add style notes in Settings → Brand kit. AI-generated images will follow your brand guidelines.

accountBrief.title: Account brief
accountBrief.text: Write a short brief for each X account in Settings → Account brief. This helps the AI understand your voice and audience.

multipleAccounts.title: Multiple accounts
multipleAccounts.text: Add as many X accounts as you need. Each keeps its own pipeline, schedule, and image styles.

imageStyles.title: Image styles
imageStyles.text: Create reusable image style templates per account so your visuals stay consistent across posts.

tips.0: Generate more drafts than you need, then curate aggressively.
tips.1: Keep one idea per post; save threads and dense announcements for later iterations.
tips.2: Use concrete image feedback like composition, object, color, or layout changes.
tips.3: Schedule around the moments your audience is likely to read, not just when content is ready.

meta.title: Impulso — Your team's content engine for X
meta.description: Impulso is the warm, all-in-one workspace where content teams generate, curate, design, and schedule posts for X.

hero.headline: A content engine your whole team can run.
hero.lead: Impulso brings idea generation, curation, design, and scheduling for X into one warm, focused workspace. Free to start — open it and go.

nova.body: Most teams have a finishing problem, not a content problem.

tomo.body: Here's what our calendar looks like this week 👇

kira.body: One idea → a week of content. Save this 🧵

stats.accountsLabel: manage every brand in one place

logos.lead: Built by teams who ship on X every day

pipeline.title: Three stages. One smooth flow.
pipeline.lead: Every post moves through the same simple path — so nothing gets stuck in someone's drafts folder.

generate.title: Generate
generate.body: Start from a topic, a link, or a rough thought. Impulso drafts on-brand posts and threads in your voice — dozens at a time.

curate.title: Curate & design
curate.body: Pick the keepers, refine the copy, and drop on matching visuals. Approve as a team — drafts become designed posts ready to go.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: Drag posts onto a calendar tuned to when your audience is online. Set it, and Impulso ships the whole week for you.

features.title: Built for the way teams actually publish.
features.lead: No glue, no exports, no "who has the latest draft?" Just one calm place to make great content together.

brandVoice.title: Stays in your brand voice
brandVoice.body: Teach Impulso your tone once. Every generated draft sounds like you — not like a robot — across each account you run.

visuals.title: Visuals, attached
visuals.body: Generate or drop in images that match each post — no separate design round-trip.

calendar.title: Smart calendar
calendar.body: A week-at-a-glance schedule that suggests the best times and auto-publishes.

approvals.title: Team approvals
approvals.body: Comment, edit, and approve together. Everyone sees the same live board.

analytics.title: See what's working
analytics.body: Lightweight performance signals flow back into the board, so your next batch of drafts leans into the formats your audience already loves.

workspace.title: Run every account from a single home.
workspace.lead: Switch between brands without losing context. Each account keeps its own voice, calendar, and team — all under one roof.

switching.title: Instant account switching
switching.body: Jump between brands in a click — context, drafts, and calendar follow you.

roles.title: Roles for everyone
roles.body: Writers draft, editors approve, managers oversee — with the right access per account.

billing.title: Separate voices, one bill
billing.body: Each brand keeps its own tone and queue while you manage it all from a single workspace.

cta.body: Open Impulso and turn this week's ideas into a full calendar of posts — no setup, no card, no catch.

footer.tagline: The warm, all-in-one workspace where content teams generate, curate, design, and schedule for X.
footer.madeFor: Made for content teams on X
